Shifting: He can shift for 14 rounds, divided as he wishes. When he shifts he gains 2 claw attacks and a bite attack, as well as a +2 racial bonus to strength (figured into the attacks).

For 5, you can move normally regardless of magical effects that impede movement, as if you were affected by freedom of movement. This effect occurs automatically as soon as it applies. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.
